title: When the Wolf Burns
author: Isandro Villalobos
blurb: Ada Winterbourne, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
